$meta.name: The Living Past — locked design tokens
$meta.source: living_past/SCOPE.md §4 (frozen). Single source of truth for the PSD template and the Astro site.
$meta.note: Two size scales: 'mockup_px' = px at the 1180px preview poster; 'master_pt' = points on the 24x36in 300dpi master (10800x7200 px). master_px = mockup_px * 9.153; master_pt = master_px * 0.24.

layout.zone_dividers: none (gradient fade to depths); single faint hairline above facts band allowed

scale.note: Surface giants sized at 270 px/m both axes. Root-depth and ocean-depth compressed on labeled rulers (Law #2). Re-derive px_per_m per volume from that volume's widest titan.

display.license: SIL OFL (Cinzel); upgrade to licensed Trajan Pro allowed

brass_finish.large_elements_sheen: optional brushed layer-style on elements >= ~1.5cm only (master QR frame, confidence-key plate)

confidence_badge.geometry: one brass dot, 1px brass ring, three fill levels

qr.encodes: jrk.art/x/<id> (stable ID-redirect, never a page URL)
qr.default_render: dark modules #0d0f10 on ivory quiet-zone tile; brass tint only if printed scan test passes
qr.gate: contrast/scan test at true 0.5in before final lock

depth_zones.treatment: thin brass hairlines fading from right edge, dissolve before crossing open water

asteroid_whisper.placement: faint cold point + short streak, top-left empty indigo sky
asteroid_whisper.note: echoes K–Pg timeline mark; subtle, not a competing monument

scale_key.layout: horizontal metre-ruled strip in facts band
scale_key.contents: 1.8m human silhouette + volume's largest organism to true scale

type_icons.style: brass silhouettes, single weight, common baseline

timeline.invariant: same line all 7 volumes; only pin moves

globe.invariant: same element all 7 volumes; continents drift
